Title: Planer Serwisu - unconfirmed parts icon: displayed in tooltip with correct name and translation
Preconditions:
User is logged in
Calendar page (BOK or Warsztat) is loaded
Repair exists with field 'Części' = Wymagane
Parts confirmation has NOT been performed

Step: Hover over the task to display the tooltip.

Verify event icons section at the bottom of the tooltip:
- icon: box-open
- name: 'Części niepotwierdzone'
Switch application language and verify if event name is translated accordingly.

Title: Planer Serwisu - unconfirmed parts icon: priority order alongside other event icons
Preconditions:
User is logged in
Calendar page (BOK or Warsztat) is loaded
Repair exists with 'Części niepotwierdzone' event AND at least one other event assigned to the same task

Step: Verify position of 'Części niepotwierdzone' icon relative to other icons on the task (left to right).
Expected result: Icon position matches priority/order configured in system settings for this event type.
